setup.tagline: First-time setup — we guide you one step at a time.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to RNode and the Bitcoin Ecosystem.
setup.welcome.body: This box is your home internet router and a Bitcoin full node. Setup takes a few minutes — just follow each screen. Join Wi‑Fi rnode with the password printed on the label, or use a LAN cable.
setup.security.title: Security
setup.security.body: We are now going to make sure that your connection to your router is secure, which means it is safe. To start the process, click on the Enable Secure Connection button below. This will download a small file to this computer. Open the file and follow the prompts; this will enable the secure connection; you will need to provide the password to this device.
setup.choice.title: Setup
setup.choice.body: Choose how you want to set up this router.
setup.choice.quick_note: Recommended for non-technical people — the factory settings are used, which is fine.
setup.choice.guided_note: Recommended for technical people — customise the Wi‑Fi name, LAN IP range and node choice.
setup.quick.title: Quick Start
setup.quick.body: Set a new router password and a new Wi‑Fi password (not the factory password printed on the label). Everything else uses the factory defaults (Wi‑Fi name rnode, Bitcoin Core node, automatic internet).
setup.pppoe.title: Internet provider login
setup.pppoe.body: No internet address yet. If your ISP gave you a username and password, enter them here — or skip and set up internet later in Settings.
setup.locale.title: Language & timezone
setup.locale.body: Pick how you want this site (and Router settings) to look, and where you live for the clock. Tap each box to open a list, then choose one line.
setup.password.title: Router password
setup.password.body: Create a new router password. You will need it later for Settings and Router settings. Do not reuse the temporary factory password.
setup.wan.title: Internet
setup.wan.pppoe: My ISP needs a username and password
setup.wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
setup.wifi.body: Choose a new Wi‑Fi name and password that phones and laptops will use. You cannot keep the factory password.
setup.wifi.none: Wi‑Fi is not available on this unit.
setup.wifi.ssid_hint: Default is rnode. You can change it.
setup.wifi.key_hint: At least 8 characters (WPA2: 8–63). Must not be the factory password printed on the label.
setup.node.title: Bitcoin node
setup.node.body: Choose which Bitcoin software this box runs. Both are full nodes and share the same chain data on the disk. If you are unsure, leave Bitcoin Core selected (recommended).
setup.tls.title: Secure connection
setup.tls.body: Install this router’s certificate. If Firefox asks to Allow or Save the download, you must click that.
setup.tls.later: You can finish trust later from Trust / HTTPS help. Until then the browser may warn.
setup.lan.title: Advanced — LAN address
setup.lan.body: Most homes should leave this alone and tap Continue. Only change LAN IP if someone told you to.
setup.done.title: You’re set
setup.done.body: Setup is finished. Next you will see Node Status while the Bitcoin node starts and catches up with the network (this can take a long time — that is normal).
setup.restart.title: Restarting Router to Apply Selected Settings
brand.tagline.status: Your home router and Bitcoin full node.
setup.welcome.body_nowifi: This box is your home internet router and a Bitcoin full node. Setup takes a few minutes — just follow each screen. Wi‑Fi is off until Setup is finished — connect a LAN cable from this box to your computer.
setup.welcome.join: Join Wi‑Fi rnode with the password printed on the label — or plug a LAN cable from this box into your computer.
setup.welcome.join_nowifi: Plug a LAN cable from this box into your computer (Wi‑Fi is off until Setup is finished).
